procedures.title: Review and freeze orchestrator contracts in PR 51
procedures.purpose: Verify that module, event and product graph contracts are coherent, non-duplicative and remain fail-closed before runtime validation.
procedures.trigger: PR 51 is open as draft and contains the initial contracts.

preconditions.expression: PR 51 state is open and draft

steps.action: Review the diff and compare contract boundaries with existing IntentIR and runtime job schemas.
steps.command_or_method: Pull request diff review and source comparison
steps.expected_output: Review decision with corrections, freeze note or explicit gaps
steps.checkpoint: review comment and current head SHA
steps.rollback: keep PR draft and revert branch commits if necessary

acceptance_criteria: No duplicated IntentIR or runtime job authority
Unknown evidence remains TOKEN_VAZIO or BLOCKED
procedures.safe_state: PR remains draft and no main branch mutation occurs
procedures.rollback: Revert branch commits or create a superseding contract version
procedures.state_reason: Contracts exist in draft PR; formal review and executable validation are pending.

token_vazio.reason: Draft 2020-12 validation has not been executed.
token_vazio.context_preserved: Schemas, fixtures, branch and PR metadata are preserved.
token_vazio.next_verifiable_step: Execute PROC-ORQ-002 after review stabilizes the contracts.

r3.F_ok: Contracts, fixtures and draft PR are materialized.
r3.F_gap: Formal review and executable validation remain pending.
r3.F_next: Finish contract review and keep the PR draft until preflight evidence exists.

procedures.title: Execute dependency-free orchestrator preflight
procedures.purpose: Produce a real structural validation report without claiming Android, Termux, VM or cross-repository runtime coverage.
procedures.trigger: PROC-ORQ-001 review declares contracts stable enough for execution.

steps.action: Run the dependency-free structural preflight and capture stdout, stderr, exit code and environment.
steps.executor: Mapa CI or authorized local runtime
steps.retry_policy: retry only after code or fixture correction
steps.checkpoint: report JSON and tested commit SHA

procedures.state_reason: Code exists, but no executed report has been attached.

token_vazio.reason: No execution log or report is attached.
token_vazio.context_preserved: Validator code, fixtures and expected command are known.
token_vazio.next_verifiable_step: Run the command in CI or an authorized local checkout and attach the JSON report.

r3.F_ok: Preflight code and inputs are present.
r3.F_next: Execute and attach a report bound to a commit and environment.

procedures.title: Create malformed contract corpus and prove rejection
procedures.purpose: Demonstrate that invalid identifiers, states, references and incomplete gaps are rejected for the expected reason.

preconditions.expression: PROC-ORQ-002 final report status equals PASS

steps.action: Generate malformed fixtures from the valid baseline.
Validate every malformed fixture and assert the expected rejection class.
steps.expected_output: Rejection report with zero unexpected accepts
steps.retry_policy: correct schema or test expectation and rerun

procedures.safe_state: Test-only changes remain on draft branch
procedures.rollback: Revert malformed fixtures and test commits
procedures.state_reason: Negative corpus and rejection tests have not been implemented.

token_vazio.reason: Negative fixtures do not exist yet.
token_vazio.context_preserved: Required invalid classes and dependency on preflight are defined.
token_vazio.next_verifiable_step: Create deterministic negative fixtures after PROC-ORQ-002 passes.

r3.F_ok: Negative validation objective and acceptance rules are declared.
r3.F_gap: Corpus and executed rejection report are absent.
r3.F_next: Generate invalid fixtures only after the positive preflight passes.

procedures.title: Implement Universal Doctor read-only
procedures.purpose: Measure module health and observed capabilities before any mutating orchestration is enabled.
procedures.trigger: O0 and O1 are supported by executed evidence.

preconditions.expression: O0 MODULE_REGISTERED and O1 CONTRACT_VALID are satisfied

steps.action: Implement a read-only probe runner and honest state classifier in RafGitTools.
steps.expected_output: Doctor report model and probe runner
steps.rollback: disable feature flag or revert the implementation commit

steps.action: Execute the Doctor against a bounded initial registry without mutation.
steps.expected_output: PASS, PASS_LIMITED, FAIL, BLOCKED or TOKEN_VAZIO per module
steps.retry_policy: rerun only after probe or environment correction

acceptance_criteria: Every uncertain result contains TOKEN_VAZIO with a next step
procedures.safe_state: Diagnostic-only; no repository, Drive or device mutation
procedures.rollback: Disable feature flag and revert draft PR commits
procedures.state_reason: Contracts require executed validation before implementation can be treated as ready.

token_vazio.reason: No unified read-only probe runner exists.
token_vazio.context_preserved: ToolRouter, governance gate and module roles are mapped.
token_vazio.next_verifiable_step: Open a separate RafGitTools draft PR after O0 and O1 evidence exists.

r3.F_ok: Universal Doctor is selected as the first functional product.
r3.F_gap: Runner, reports and real probe evidence are absent.
r3.F_next: Implement in a separate read-only RafGitTools draft PR after contract validation.

procedures.title: Execute G12 rclone inventory-only run
procedures.purpose: Create the first real bounded inventory manifest without altering local or Drive originals.
procedures.trigger: The authorized user starts the G12 runbook in MODE=inventory on Termux.

preconditions.expression: rclone remote and local source are available with reviewed filters

steps.action: Generate local and remote lsjson inventories, sizes, logs and a run manifest.
steps.expected_output: RUN_ID directory with local/remote inventories and manifest
steps.retry_policy: resume by creating a new RUN_ID after reviewing the failure
steps.rollback: remove derived local run only after preserving required evidence

procedures.rollback: Remove only derived local run artifacts after archival decision
procedures.state_reason: Runbook is implementable, but no real Termux run has been supplied.

token_vazio.reason: No inventory execution output has been received from the device.
token_vazio.context_preserved: Runbook, remote root, filters, states and expected outputs are defined.
token_vazio.next_verifiable_step: Run MODE=inventory on Termux and attach the generated manifest and JSON log.

r3.F_ok: The inventory procedure is bounded and non-destructive.
r3.F_gap: The first real RUN_ID remains TOKEN_VAZIO.
r3.F_next: Execute on the authorized Termux device and register the resulting manifest.
